xydesk.audio_mic: ok (policy fDisableAudioCapture=, WinStations=0) - mic HP redirect aktif, Allow di HP
xydesk.wallpaper_rdp: ok (policy fNoRemoteDesktopWallpaper=) - wallpaper RDP tampil, cek client Experience→Wallpaper ON
xydesk.rdp_probe: awal=True multi=True audio=True grafis=True clear=True fw=True svc=True
xydesk.quic_udp4433: dibuka di VM (tidak lewat tunnel TCP)
xydesk.note: Host siap dipakai klien XyDesk Remote mode Koneksi RDP (Host+Port tunnel). Kunci WinStations\RDP-Tcp sengaja TIDAK ditulis supaya listener 3389 tidak mati di runner GitHub.

tailscale.note: HP/PC harus login Tailscale pada tailnet yang sama. TCP 3389 harus diizinkan ACL.
